thread:
Alex G: Kicking off v2 routing service deploy in change window. Plan: enable feature flag `route_v2` to 5% for 15m, monitor p95 latency & 5xx rate, then 25% -> 75% -> 100% if green. Pin service-route to v2.3.1 for the rollout.

deploy-bot: queued deploy #2198 by Alex G — scheduled start 2026-03-21T02:15:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 2198`.

Jamie L: leaving a note — please add the telemetry gate (latency + errors) and a soft rollback trigger. :eyes:

Priya S: Agreed. Gate: auto-hold if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 increases by >50ms vs baseline. If hold, escalate to SRE and product.

Marta S: Recommend start at 2% for first 10m to avoid oscillation, then 2->8->30->100. Also request pinning routing instances to v2.3.1 and sticky session check.

Chris T: OK for 2% start. Command I'll run: `ffctl rollout route_v2 --set 2% --steps 2,8,30,100 --step-duration 10m --auto-hold "5xx>0.5% || p95_delta>50ms"`

Danielle P: Product asks to watch UI error banner for first cohort — if any client-side JS errors spike, hold and notify #product.

Alex G: Confirming: Chris runs the `ffctl` command, deploy-bot will flip flag cohorts and we leave deploy pinned to v2.3.1. If rollback needed we run `/deploy rollback 2198` and set `route_v2=off` + pin back to v2.2.8.

deploy-bot: flag `route_v2` changed to 2% (cohort alpha) by Chris T. Audit id: afb-1192.

Priya S: Quick sanity check on config: are cache TTLs preserved when switching route? We should invalidate prefix cache for cohort alpha only.

Chris T: I've added cache invalidation hook for cohort alpha in the deploy: `scripts/invalidate_prefix_cache --cohort alpha` — will run post-toggle.

Marta S: Observability links: latency dashboard https://console/redwood/obs/dashboards/route_v2_p95 and errors https://console/redwood/obs/dashboards/route_v2_5xx. Watch `region=us-east` first.

Jamie L: If we hit auto-hold, what's rollback policy? Full rollback or step back?

Alex G: Auto-hold -> manual review. If errors persist for 2 consecutive checks (10m) then full rollback and pin to v2.2.8. If single spike, step back to previous cohort (e.g., 8->2).

Danielle P: noted. I'll be on standby for UI checks and can approve ramp once product-signoff passes.

Chris T: 15m mark looks green so far in alpha. p95 +12ms, 5xx at 0.12%. Proceeding to 8% now.

deploy-bot: flag `route_v2` advanced to 8% by Chris T.

Marta S: No abnormal SRE alerts. Keeping an eye on backend worker queue depths.

Chris T: 30% next if green at 25m. Will post updates.

Alex G: Thanks team. If anyone sees anything urgent ping @marta and use `/deploy rollback 2198` as needed. :thumbsup:

Jamie L: :thumbsup:

Danielle P: :+1:

Chris T: moving to 30% now — will report back at 40m.

deploy-bot: flag `route_v2` advanced to 30% by Chris T.

Chris T: 40m — metrics stable, p95 +18ms, 5xx 0.19%. Ramp to 75% in 10m.

Marta S: Approved to continue. Remember to watch regional splits during the 75% step.

Alex G: If anything crosses the threshold, we roll back and capture logs with `trace-capture --deploy 2198 --window 15m`.

Chris T: Ramp to 75% done.

deploy-bot: flag `route_v2` advanced to 75% by Chris T.

Danielle P: no UI regressions observed in cohorts. Green from product perspective.

Alex G: final step to 100% in 15m if telemetry holds. I'll update release notes with rollout details and pin history.

Chris T: 15m passed, metrics stable. Advancing to 100% now.

deploy-bot: flag `route_v2` advanced to 100% by Chris T.

Alex G: Rollout complete. Deploy #2198 is healthy. Release notes: "v2 routing rollout 2026-03-21 — started at 2%, gates: p95/+50ms, 5xx>0.5%. Pinned v2.3.1 during rollout. No rollback required."

Marta S: I'll unpin after 24h if stable.

Danielle P: Thanks everyone. Closing the change window. :white_check_mark:
